headlines.title: FDA orders new warning on GLP-1s over rare eye condition linked to sudden blindness
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration said Monday that GLP-1 drugmakers must add a warning label about a rare eye condition that can cause sudden blindness.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: How Parents Can Give Themselves Grace During the Holidays
headlines.description: Sissy Goff and David Thomas, licensed professional counselors and New York Times bestselling authors of “Capable: How to Teach Your Kids the Strengths, Skills and Strategies to Build Reslience,” join TODAY to discuss ways that moms and dads can give themselves grace and enjoy the overwhelming holiday season.

headlines.title: NBC's Chloe Melas Opens Up About Journey With IBD
headlines.description: NBC’s Chloe Melas joins TODAY to share her new book “The Girl’s Guide to Guts: Everything Your Doc Didn’t Tell You But Your Bestie Would,” opening up about her journey with ulcerative colitis. NBC’s medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar also breaks down the biggest misconceptions of inflammatory bowel disease.

headlines.title: New Weight Loss Drug Could Also Treat Knee Arthritis: Study
headlines.description: A recent poll found about 1-in-8 American adults say they’re currently taking GLP-1 weight loss drugs and now a study in The England Journal of Medicine finds that one drug, retatrutide, currently in trials, could also provide significant relief for people suffering from painful knee arthritis. NBC medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal joins TODAY to break down those findings.

headlines.title: Chloe Melas on New Book ‘The Girl’s Guide to Guts’
headlines.description: After coping with stomach issues for 15 years, NBC entertainment correspondent Chloe Melas joins TODAY to open up about her struggles with ulcerative colitis and how she's hoping to help others with her new book, "The Girl's Guide to Guts."

headlines.title: Talking Shop with Poppi founder Allison Ellsworth about her new beverage brand, Jetty
headlines.description: Poppi founder Allison Ellsworth just launched Jetty, a hydration brand that sells drinks and powders. She gave NBC Selected a behind-the-scenes look into building it.

headlines.description: The Nespresso Vertuo Pop coffee and espresso maker is on sale for $85 at Walmart for a limited time. It brews five drink sizes and heats up in 30 seconds.

headlines.description: We rounded up the best gifts for dads for this holiday season. Shop our favorite picks, including Apple AirPods and iPads, Yeti tumblers and Brooks sneakers.

headlines.title: NBC’s Chloe Melas Shares 1st Symptoms of Bowel Disease She Almost Ignored
headlines.description: In her early 20s, NBC’s Chloe Melas was navigating New York City as a busy young journalist. But she developed digestive issues that turned out to be serious.
